61
Awerɛkyekyerɛ a ɛbɛba no
1 # Mat 11.5; Luk 4.18-19 AWURADE Nyankopɔn honhom wɔ me so,
ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE asra me ngo
sɛ menka asɛmpa menkyerɛ amanehunufoɔ;
wasoma me sɛ memmɛkyekyere wɔn a wɔn akoma abubuo werɛ,
mempae ahofadie menkyerɛ nnommum
ne nneduadan bue menkyerɛ apokyerɛfoɔ,
2 # Lew 25.10; Yes 63.4 na mempae AWURADE anisɔ afe
ne yɛn Nyankopɔn aweretɔ da no,
menkyekyere abooboodifoɔ nyinaa werɛ,
3menhyehyɛ Sion abooboodifoɔ
memma wɔnnɛnso nsi nso mu da ananmu,
memma wɔn anika ngo nsi abooboo ananmu,
memma wɔn ayeyie ntadeɛ nsi honhom a watɔ bera ananmu,
na wɔmfrɛ wɔn tenenee nnua,
AWURADE tɛ nnua a ɛhyɛ no animuonyam.
4Na wɔbɛkyekyere tete akurofo
ama akanefoɔ amamfo so agyina,
na wɔayɛ nkuro agoago
ne awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ amamfo no foforɔ.
5 # Yes 60.10-16 Na ahɔhoɔ bɛgyina ahwɛ mo nnwan,
na ananafoɔ ayeyɛ mo akuafoɔ ne mo turoyɛfoɔ.
6 # Yes 66.21 Na mo deɛ, wɔbɛfrɛ mo AWURADE asɔfoɔ,
na wɔase mo sɛ: Yɛn Nyankopɔn asomfo;
mobɛdi amanaman ahonyadeɛ,
na wɔn adedodoɔ mu na mobɛhoahoa mo ho.
7 # Yes 40.2 Mo aniwuo no ananmu mobɛnya mmɔho,
na ahohora ananmu mobɛdi mo kyɛfa ho ahurisie;
ɛno nti mobɛnya mmɔho, mo asase so,
daa anigyeɛ bɛyɛ mo dea.
8 # Yes 54.10; 55.3 Na me, AWURADE, medɔ atemmuo,
mekyiri atirimuɔden ne adwotwa,
na mɛtua wɔn ka nokorɛ mu,
na me ne wɔn apam daa apam.
9Na wɔbɛhunu wɔn asefoɔ, amanaman mu,
ne wɔn mma wɔ aman mu;
obiara a n’ani bɔ wɔn soɔ no bɛhu wɔn sɛ
wɔyɛ ɔman a AWURADE ahyira wɔn.
10 # Mat 22.11-12 AWURADE mu na me ho sɛpɛ me,
na me Nyankopɔn mu na me kra di ahurisie,
ɛfiri sɛ ɔde nkwagyeɛ atadeɛ ahyɛ me,
ɔde tenenee batakari asi me,
sɛ ayeforɔkunu a ɔkeka ne ho bɔ n’abotire,
ne ayeforɔ a ɔde ne nnwinneɛ hyehyɛ ne ho.
11Na sɛdeɛ asase ma afifideɛ pue
na turo ma deɛ wɔadua mu fifire no,
saa ara na AWURADE Nyankopɔn bɛma tenenee ne ayeyie
afifiri amanaman nyinaa anim.

pageProps.chapterText:
AWURADE Nyankopɔn honhom wɔ me so,
ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE asra me ngo
sɛ menka asɛmpa menkyerɛ amanehunufoɔ;
wasoma me sɛ memmɛkyekyere wɔn a wɔn akoma abubuo werɛ,
mempae ahofadie menkyerɛ nnommum
ne nneduadan bue menkyerɛ apokyerɛfoɔ,
na mempae AWURADE anisɔ afe
ne yɛn Nyankopɔn aweretɔ da no,
menkyekyere abooboodifoɔ nyinaa werɛ,
menhyehyɛ Sion abooboodifoɔ
memma wɔnnɛnso nsi nso mu da ananmu,
memma wɔn anika ngo nsi abooboo ananmu,
memma wɔn ayeyie ntadeɛ nsi honhom a watɔ bera ananmu,
na wɔmfrɛ wɔn tenenee nnua,
AWURADE tɛ nnua a ɛhyɛ no animuonyam.
Na wɔbɛkyekyere tete akurofo
ama akanefoɔ amamfo so agyina,
na wɔayɛ nkuro agoago
ne awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ amamfo no foforɔ.

Na ahɔhoɔ bɛgyina ahwɛ mo nnwan,
na ananafoɔ ayeyɛ mo akuafoɔ ne mo turoyɛfoɔ.
Na mo deɛ, wɔbɛfrɛ mo AWURADE asɔfoɔ,
na wɔase mo sɛ: Yɛn Nyankopɔn asomfo;
mobɛdi amanaman ahonyadeɛ,
na wɔn adedodoɔ mu na mobɛhoahoa mo ho.
Mo aniwuo no ananmu mobɛnya mmɔho,
na ahohora ananmu mobɛdi mo kyɛfa ho ahurisie;
ɛno nti mobɛnya mmɔho, mo asase so,
daa anigyeɛ bɛyɛ mo dea.

Na me, AWURADE, medɔ atemmuo,
mekyiri atirimuɔden ne adwotwa,
na mɛtua wɔn ka nokorɛ mu,
na me ne wɔn apam daa apam.
Na wɔbɛhunu wɔn asefoɔ, amanaman mu,
ne wɔn mma wɔ aman mu;
obiara a n’ani bɔ wɔn soɔ no bɛhu wɔn sɛ
wɔyɛ ɔman a AWURADE ahyira wɔn.

AWURADE mu na me ho sɛpɛ me,
na me Nyankopɔn mu na me kra di ahurisie,
ɛfiri sɛ ɔde nkwagyeɛ atadeɛ ahyɛ me,
ɔde tenenee batakari asi me,
sɛ ayeforɔkunu a ɔkeka ne ho bɔ n’abotire,
ne ayeforɔ a ɔde ne nnwinneɛ hyehyɛ ne ho.
Na sɛdeɛ asase ma afifideɛ pue
na turo ma deɛ wɔadua mu fifire no,
saa ara na AWURADE Nyankopɔn bɛma tenenee ne ayeyie
afifiri amanaman nyinaa anim.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
